semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in laser processing technologies that are critical for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Ｌ.P.S. WORKS develops and manufactures advanced laser processing machines, including equipment for prototyping, development, and mass production in the semiconductor industry. Their expertise in ultrashort pulse lasers enables high-precision micro-processing of various materials, making them a valuable partner for companies in need of specialized laser processing solutions.
capabilities: Laser micro-processing technology for precision drilling and cutting
Custom-made laser processing equipment with optimized optics and mechanics
Prototyping and mass production using picosecond and femtosecond lasers
Precision processing of glass and ceramic substrates

regional_presence.Japan: The company is based in Japan and has a strong history of developing laser processing technologies within the region.
